summary: 18.5, paragraph "Acceptance with limits (GF-CLOSE-6 ...)": it says "so a scope that does not close for another reason (a standing no-go, a missing review step, a battery or the accounting is not a finding) cannot be accepted either, and needs a new round", but the refusal conditions it lists (actor user; clean tree; neither closed nor already accepted; the list holds every open finding exactly once with severity, L-GF-<n> and a 30+ character reason, nothing else; none blocking; not empty) constrain only the findings list. A reader cannot tell whether a scope that has open non-blocking findings AND also a standing readiness no-go or a missing review step can be accepted (the conditions say yes; the quoted sentence, read literally, says no), and so cannot tell what a gf.slice.accepted event asserts about the scope's non-finding closure conditions or whether the owner is accepting a standing no-go that the event does not list. The text should say either 'only for another reason' or add the condition.
